Cluster.//Provision: false = connect to a stack already running (docker-cache-test/up.ps1), which keeps the local edit-and-rerun loop fast. true = the fixture provisions SQL + Redis + the API instances itself via Testcontainers, so `dotnet test` needs nothing but Docker. Override with SHA_Cluster__Provision=true.
Cluster.//BaseUrls: Used in external mode only. In managed mode the fixture overwrites these with the randomly mapped container ports.
Cluster.//TestSetting: An int setting owned by Shesha.CacheTests.Host itself, so nothing else reads it and mutating it is free. Cache key is <Module>.<Name>.
Cluster.//TestTreeType: Must be a type whose GetAllTree result is genuinely nested; an empty tree would make the shared-instance test pass vacuously.
Cluster.//TestApiTarget: An inert endpoint in Shesha.CacheTests.Host. Real framework services inherit app:Configurator from their parent, so a failed restore there would leave working APIs locked down.
